info.name: Purple Haze / 紫霧主題 for Mastodon [260207 UPDATE]
info.description: I initially created this plain purple theme for cmx.im in 2018. The old version broke with the Mastodon v4.0 update, so I decided to rewrite the code from scratch using modern CSS variables. Hope you enjoy this resurrection! XD //Inspired by Sogo Osaka from Idolish7 // Works with most of the Mastodon instances. Feel free to use it in your own instance. (Don't forget to add the domain at the list) Grey background version (I'll update it later): Purple Haze (Grey background) for Mastodon Suggestions for improvement are always appreciated. <3 ———————————— 紫霧主題 / Purple Haze 主題是2018年寫的，但是一直沒有做更新，現在毛象已經更新到4.6.0也加了好多新功能，終於徹底更新了一版，適配大部分已更新的Mastodon實例（4.6.0可用） 背景為深紫色，灰色版本請至 Purple Haze (Grey background) for Mastodon 歡迎使用和提出意見。
